store.name: Lumen Market
store.promise: A small shop that runs itself. You set the variables. The agents do the rest.

products.name: Oat field tote
products.blurb: A quiet everyday bag. Heavy linen, short handles, one inside pocket.
products.details: Made for market runs and laptops that do not need a speech. Holds a notebook, a bottle, and a small haul. Spot clean. Ships in 3 to 5 days once the Inventory Agent confirms stock.

products.name: Sand pour-over carafe
products.blurb: Matte ceramic. Holds enough for two cups and no more.
products.details: Hand-finished stoneware in a warm sand glaze. Not dishwasher safe. The Pricing Agent reviews this price weekly against supplier cost and return rate.

products.name: Copper stripe throw
products.blurb: Merino blend. Cream and copper. For the end of the sofa.
products.details: Lightweight enough for a desk chair, warm enough for a late evening. Dry clean. Member price applies after the Household membership is active.

products.name: Sage field notes
products.blurb: A short digital playbook for running a one-person shop with agents.
products.details: Included with Household membership. One-time purchase unlocks the same file. The Content Agent revises it monthly. You download it from the member page after payment.

plans.name: Household
plans.pitch: The reasonable paywall. Early drops and member prices.
includes: Early access to the next drop
One support thread with the Customer Agent

plans.name: Atelier
plans.pitch: For people who want the shop to remember them.
